transport.requestHandling: JSDOM request interceptor plus injected fetch; no TCP listener
transport.socketHandling: in-memory socket shim; browser Socket.IO bundle pinned in closure manifest but not executed; synthetic disconnect/connect retains registered event handlers

evidence.initial: Synthetic timer renders 01:30 in each locale.
evidence.update: Matching advanced-timer:tick changes rendered value to 01:29; nonmatching timer id is ignored.
evidence.reloadRecovery: HTTP 404, 503 and synthetic network failure show expected error; a new JSDOM load then renders the synthetic timer again.
evidence.cleanup: pagehide disconnects and removes handlers; deferred HTTP completion after pagehide cannot render/register listeners; no recurring timer remains.
evidence.syntheticReconnect: in de/en/es/fr the in-memory shim emits disconnect then connect without clearing renderer handlers; a later matching tick updates from 01:30 to 01:28, and pagehide then clears handlers and rejects reconnect after renderer cleanup.
evidence.bfcache: persisted pagehide keeps the same shim handlers and a later synthetic tick updates; this is lifecycle restoration.

separateBrowserReceipt.scope: separate synthetic loopback Socket.IO and Playwright browser run; not part of the in-process JSDOM fixture

notProven: product Socket.IO/browser transport reconnect against the LTTH server; the separate receipt tests only the synthetic loopback host
product route or database behavior; the separate receipt uses the synthetic host route
